protocol.development: The 0.5B pilot was inspected before selecting this 1.5B follow-up. Prompts, questions, and strict validators were kept fixed. This is a development comparison, not an untouched model-selection test.

documents.text: The fictional Orchid study uses 800 Monte Carlo repetitions and seed 41. It studies iid exponential samples of size 30.
The fictional Birch study uses 1200 Monte Carlo repetitions and seed 73. It studies iid normal samples of size 60.
Split conformal prediction has marginal coverage under exchangeability of calibration and future examples. This does not guarantee conditional coverage for every covariate value.
An ordinary iid bootstrap resamples observations independently. Dependent time series require a resampling procedure that preserves appropriate dependence, such as a block bootstrap.
